title: JSON State and File Resource Storage
scope_completed: implemented the authoritative r3 JSON StateRepository with strict startup validation, deep-copy reads, conditional whole-state mutation, atomic current/previous replacement, fail-stop reload semantics, and exact typed state-read failures

implemented platform-aware instance locking, shared reentrant publication coordination, attachment upload capabilities, exact-handle durability, path containment, link rejection, and injectable clocks, IDs, replacements, synchronization, and fault points

implemented content-only staging, staged validation, deterministic target planning, atomic Case capacity accounting including formal orphans and durable-outbox targets, idempotent formal publication, strict reads, and read-only file/tree materialization

implemented immutable Job and Outcome execution records, bounded append-only log sinks, retention discovery, durable-outbox protection, two-phase quarantine, cleanup retries, and publication-versus-cleanup barriers
adopted r3 attachment archive workspace suffixes without changing formal payload/tree keys and produced deterministic r3 state, atomic-fault, hash-mismatch, and workspace-path fixtures

505 passed in 1.40s on the committed implementation head

all storage production and unit-test modules compiled successfully
41 implementation files, all within the S02 write allowlist

known_limitations: No on-read or online StateFile migration is implemented: a pre-release v1-contract-r2 state is rejected and requires explicit offline migration or regeneration before r3 startup.
risks: S08 composition must inject the same StorageCoordinationLock and the same attachment/stage registries into every S02 adapter and cleaner; duplicate instances would invalidate publication, upload, and cleanup exclusion guarantees.
integration_notes: The S02-relevant r2 contract gaps are resolved by v1-contract-r3; there are no unresolved or new contract change requests.

StateRepository read_snapshot, read_case, read_job, and read_artifact preserve STATE_CORRUPT or STATE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED after an unrecoverable reload, while commit closes to STATE_WRITE_FAILED and validate_all remains a ValidationReport channel.

ResourceStore.validate_case_capacity must execute under the shared publication lease; its RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED detail uses limit=MAX_CASE_RESOURCE_BYTES and observed from the same atomic CaseResourceUsage.total_bytes that counts every unique formal key, including orphan and durable-outbox targets.

Attachment formal storage remains resources/cases/<case_id>/attachments/<attachment_id>/payload. S04 must derive the exact workspace destination from immutable Attachment name/content_type with the frozen r3 helpers; S02 accepts only the frozen payload suffix set and does not inspect archive contents.

RetentionCleaner must share the coordination lock, attachment registry, stage registry, ResourceStore, ExecutionRecordStore, and StateRepository used by publication; an unconfirmed finalized Outcome protects its staged refs, deterministic formal targets, and next Job until a persisted terminal processing disposition exists.
